summary: Build a platform with user roles (PAI/MÃE, FILHO, and ADMINISTRADOR) including restricted admin access and an admin dashboard with usage metrics.
architectural_notes: Implement role-based access control (RBAC) with an ADMINISTRADOR role gated by an allowlist (specific emails/phone) plus a separate admin password check.
Admin dashboard requires tracking/aggregating user counts, parent-child link counts, login events, and active-session/online presence signals.

existing_features.title: Add a third role option named “ADMINISTRATOR” to the profile creation flow, alongside Parent and Child, and allow selecting it only when the user-provided identifier matches the leader allowlist: email “tigguinrodrigues@gmail.com” or “tigguinclash@gmail.com”, or phone number “(91)980115950”.

Require a dedicated ADMINISTRATOR access step in the UI: when the logged-in user is recognized as admin by the backend, show an admin password gate screen (password input) before rendering the AdminPanel; only after successful verification in the current session may the AdminPanel be shown.

Expand the administrator dashboard metrics to include: total Parent users, total Child users, total Parent→Child link count (how many child logins are linked to a parent), total users who have ever logged in (interpreted as total saved profiles), and an estimate of how many users currently have the platform open (active sessions) based on a presence heartbeat.
Add a small set of additional admin dashboard metrics that are fully computable from current on-chain state (no external services), and display them clearly in the admin dashboard.

new_feature_requests.summary: Add a third login/access option named ADMINISTRADOR, restricted to leader accounts (allowlist emails/phone) protected by password.

Create an ADMINISTRADOR dashboard showing counts of PAI/MÃE and FILHO users, number of FILHO logins linked to PAI/MÃE, total users who logged in, currently active/open sessions, and additional platform metrics.

Implement backend enforcement for the ADMINISTRATOR role so that only leader-allowlisted accounts can save a profile with role #admin, and ensure non-allowlisted users cannot become admins even if they manipulate the frontend.

Set the admin password to “Liderdoprojetox1” and restrict admin-password changes so that only leader-allowlisted admins can change the admin password (other admins, if any, must not be able to change it).
